name: Neck Tilt Count
description: A guided neck mobility drill with slow left-right counting.
steps: Stand tall and relax your shoulders.
Tilt your head to the left and hold.
Return to center.
Tilt your head to the right and hold.
Return to center and count one rep.

voiceCues.intro: Neck tilt. Keep your shoulders relaxed and move slowly.
voiceCues.setup: Stand tall. Eyes forward. We start in three, two, one.
voiceCues.repTemplate: Tilt left. Center. Tilt right. Center. Rep {rep}.
voiceCues.setComplete: Set complete. Relax your neck and shoulders.
warnings: Stop if you feel sharp pain.

name: Shoulder Roll Count
description: A guided shoulder roll drill for warming up the upper body.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed.
Roll both shoulders forward in a full circle.
Count one rep each time the shoulders return to the top.
After the target reps, repeat backward if needed.

voiceCues.intro: Shoulder rolls. Make smooth circles and keep your neck relaxed.
voiceCues.setup: Arms loose. Start rolling in three, two, one.
voiceCues.setComplete: Set complete. Shake your arms out.

name: Bodyweight Squat Count
description: A guided squat drill to build lower-body strength for jumping and shooting balance.
steps: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips while keeping knees aligned with toes.
Hold briefly at the bottom.
Stand tall and count one rep.

voiceCues.intro: Bodyweight squats. Control the movement and keep your knees tracking over your toes.
voiceCues.setup: Feet shoulder width. Chest up. Start in three, two, one.
warnings: Keep your heels on the floor.
Do not let your knees collapse inward.
Reduce depth if your knees hurt.

name: Push Up Count
description: A guided push-up drill for upper-body strength and shooting stability.
steps: Start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest with control.
Push back to the top.
Count one rep at full extension.

voiceCues.intro: Push ups. Keep your body straight from shoulders to ankles.
voiceCues.setup: Hands under shoulders. Brace your core. Start in three, two, one.
warnings: Do not let your hips sag.
Use knee push ups if your wrist or shoulder hurts.

name: Lateral Lunge Count
description: A side-to-side mobility drill for hips, knees, and defensive basketball stance.
steps: Stand wide with toes forward.
Shift your weight to the left and bend the left knee.
Return to center.
Shift to the right and bend the right knee.
Return to center and count one rep.

voiceCues.intro: Lateral lunges. Move side to side with control.
voiceCues.setup: Wide stance. Chest up. Start in three, two, one.
voiceCues.setComplete: Set complete. Stand tall and rest.
warnings: Keep the bent knee aligned with the toes.
Do not rush the side shift.
Reduce range if your knee or groin hurts.

name: Calf Raise Count
description: A guided calf raise drill for ankle strength and jump preparation.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and count one rep.

voiceCues.intro: Calf raises. Stay tall and control every rep.
voiceCues.setup: Feet hip width. Hands on hips or a wall for balance. Start in three, two, one.
voiceCues.setComplete: Set complete. Shake out your legs.
warnings: Do not bounce at the bottom.
